candidate.subject: Keep every cursor move clear
candidate.preview_text: Adjust cursor movement, size and style after recording your product walkthrough.
candidate.headline: Keep the cursor editable after recording
candidate.body:
When a product walkthrough is recorded in Screen Studio on macOS, the cursor can still be adjusted afterward—so each move can guide viewers through the feature you are showing.

Screen Studio is screen recording software for Mac. It captures precise mouse-movement data separately from the screen, synchronizes it with the video, and adds the cursor to the final result.

That means you can smooth cursor movement or change its size and style after recording, instead of starting the walkthrough again.

When it is ready, export the finished video at up to 4K and 60 fps on every plan.

Screen Studio supports macOS only, with macOS 13.1 or later recommended.

Download and export your first video for free.

issues.detail: "Keep every cursor move clear": The sources support post-recording cursor smoothing and customization, but do not establish that every cursor move will be clear.
"so each move can guide viewers through the feature you are showing.": The sources document cursor controls, but do not establish the promised viewer-guidance outcome.

"Download and export your first video for free.": The documented download route supports downloading the Mac application, but no source establishes a free trial, free tier, or entitlement to export a first video for free.
This implies a clarity outcome not established by the cursor-customization evidence.
The sources support cursor effects but not the asserted viewer-guidance result.
No supplied source establishes free export access or any free plan or trial.
This directly violates the directions not to claim or imply a free trial, free tier, or other free workflow entitlement.

decision.summary: The core Screen Studio cursor mechanism, post-recording controls, Mac limitation, version recommendation, export specification, plan coverage, and download CTA are supported. Revision is required because the draft promises a free first export despite an explicit prohibition and no supporting entitlement evidence; its cursor-clarity and viewer-guidance outcomes also exceed the supplied sources. The section label, greeting, and signature add no separate material factual assertion.

benefit_retention.explanation: The intended benefit remains present: a walkthrough recorded in Screen Studio can have its cursor movement, size, and style refined afterward and be exported at up to 4K and 60 fps, with the macOS-only condition stated.
